title: Application container image
description: One container image of an application (applications/<app_id>/images/<image_id>.json): its immutable OCI reference, build lineage, SBOM location, signature and SLSA provenance status, latest vulnerability scan and the environments it is deployed to. Written by runtime-probe-appcontainers and probe-cicd-env

appId.description: Slug of the owning application; equals the applications/<app_id> directory name

imageId.description: Slug of this image; must equal the file name without .json and the SBOM file name without .cdx.json

ref.description: Full OCI reference as pulled: registry/repository[:tag][@sha256:digest]. Should carry the digest so the record is immutable

registry.description: Registry host (with optional port) part of ref, e.g. '123456789012.dkr.ecr.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com', 'ghcr.io' or 'docker.io'. Must contain a dot or a port (or be localhost)

repository.description: Repository path part of ref, e.g. 'arthanidhi/ledger-core-api'

tag.description: Mutable tag the image was pulled by, if any. The digest is authoritative

digest.description: Content-addressable manifest digest, 'sha256:' followed by 64 lowercase hex characters

baseImage.description: Base image reference from the final FROM line (or the OCI base-image annotation), used for end-of-life and upstream CVE checks. Normalise to fully-qualified form before writing: FROM node:22-bookworm-slim becomes docker.io/library/node:22-bookworm-slim and FROM arthanidhi/ledger:1.0 becomes docker.io/arthanidhi/ledger:1.0

sbomPath.description: Workspace path of the CycloneDX SBOM for this image, always applications/<app_id>/images/<image_id>.cdx.json

envIds.description: Environments (applications/<app_id>/env/<env_id>.json) where this exact digest is currently running. Empty when the image is built but not deployed

ociReference.description: Alias of common ociReference, kept for existing $refs

ociDigest.description: Alias of common ociDigest, kept for existing $refs

buildSource.description: Source lineage of the image: which registered repo, commit and Dockerfile produced it

repoId.description: Slug of the repo (applications/<app_id>/repos/<repo_id>.json) the image was built from

dockerfilePath.description: Dockerfile or Containerfile path relative to the repository root

signing.description: Image signature status. 'verified' is the result of Maxwell's own verification, not the registry's claim

tool.description: Signing tool: cosign (Sigstore), notation (Notary v2) or none

verified.description: True when the signature was verified against the expected key or identity during the last probe

keyRef.description: Locator of the public key or identity the signature was verified against (KMS alias URI, Fulcio identity, trust-store name). Never key material

provenanceAttestation.description: SLSA build provenance status of the image

slsaLevel.description: Highest SLSA v1.0 Build Track level (L0-L3) demonstrated by an attestation Maxwell could verify; 0 when none

attestationRef.description: Where the attestation lives: URL, Rekor log index (as 'rekor:<index>') or registry referrer digest

scanSummary.description: Severity counts from the most recent vulnerability scan of this digest. Full results live in the SBOM's vulnerabilities array and in cves/

tool.description: Scanner that produced the counts; keyed on by KPI slicing and scanner-specific severity mapping

toolVersion.description: Scanner version as reported by the tool, e.g. '0.65.0' or 'v0.92.0'

unknown.description: Count of vulnerabilities whose severity the scanner could not rate (trivy UNKNOWN, grype Negligible/Unknown); Maxwell maps them to 'info'

kevCount.description: Count of vulnerabilities listed in the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalogue, regardless of severity

fixableCounts.description: Subset of the severity counts for which the scanner reports a fixed version; the patch-SLA logic treats the remainder as unpatchable exposure that needs a compensating control or VEX statement

critical.description: Critical-severity vulnerabilities with a fix available

high.description: High-severity vulnerabilities with a fix available

medium.description: Medium-severity vulnerabilities with a fix available

low.description: Low-severity vulnerabilities with a fix available
